scope: UI motion and 3D libraries for mano-design; excludes video editing / game engines / audio processing
verification: Licenses checked 2026-11-18 (GitHub API; GSAP via https://gsap.com/licensing/). Bundle sizes and browser support are intentionally not listed: measure with the project's own bundle analyzer and target browsers.

libraries.name: motion
libraries.use_case: React 组件状态转场、layout animation、enter/exit
libraries.browser_support: Evergreen browsers; verify against project targets
libraries.pros: 声明式；自动处理布局变化；TypeScript 原生支持
libraries.cons: 包体积比纯 CSS 大；复杂动画不如 GSAP 灵活

libraries.name: three.js
libraries.browser_support: Evergreen browsers; verify against project targets
libraries.pros: 行业标准；文档完善；生态丰富；可按需导入
libraries.cons: 命令式 API；React 集成需额外封装

libraries.name: @react-three/fiber
libraries.use_case: React 中声明式使用 three.js
libraries.pros: React 组件化；hooks；自动内存清理；SSR 支持
libraries.cons: 需学习 three.js 概念；调试比原生 three.js 难

libraries.name: @react-three/drei
libraries.use_case: react-three/fiber 的辅助组件（相机控制、加载器、后处理）
libraries.pros: 开箱即用的常用功能；减少样板代码
libraries.cons: 增加包体积；部分组件有性能开销

libraries.name: lottie-web
libraries.use_case: 播放 After Effects 导出的 Bodymovin JSON 动画
libraries.browser_support: Evergreen browsers; verify against project targets
libraries.pros: 设计师友好；矢量无损；文件小
libraries.cons: 不适合手写动画；需 AE 插件导出；部分 AE 特效不支持

libraries.name: anime.js
libraries.browser_support: Evergreen browsers; verify against project targets
libraries.pros: 轻量；API 简洁；对 SVG/DOM/CSS/JS 对象统一接口
libraries.cons: 功能比 GSAP 少；无插件生态

libraries.name: GSAP
libraries.license: GSAP Standard "No Charge" License (proprietary, not OSI)
libraries.license_note: Free for commercial use, including former members-only plugins (SplitText, MorphSVG). Prohibited: use in no-code visual animation builders that compete with Webflow. Effective 2025-04-30.
libraries.browser_support: Evergreen browsers; verify against project targets
libraries.pros: 功能最强；性能优秀；插件丰富
libraries.cons: 非 OSI 开源许可，有竞争性可视化工具限制；已用 motion 的项目无需再引入
libraries.commercial_use: Allowed at no charge (see license restrictions)

libraries.name: CSS 3D Transforms
libraries.use_case: 简单 2.5D 效果、卡片翻转、视差
libraries.browser_support: Evergreen browsers; verify against project targets
libraries.pros: 无依赖；硬件加速；简单场景足够
libraries.cons: 无 Z-buffer 排序；无灯光材质；不适合复杂 3D

libraries.name: Canvas API + requestAnimationFrame
libraries.browser_support: Evergreen browsers; verify against project targets
libraries.pros: 无依赖；可控；性能可预测
libraries.cons: 需手写动画循环；复杂效果代码量大

excluded_from_ui_scope.reason: 长视频渲染、字幕对齐、编解码不属于 UI 动效；需要时单独引入
节拍检测、音频可视化、音效播放不是 UI 必需；需要时单独引入
教育讲解类内容；不适用于通用 UI；需要时单独引入
物理引擎、角色动画、地形生成超出 UI 范围；需要用专门工具

selection_rules: 已有项目栈优先（motion 已有不引入 GSAP）
MIT 许可优先；GSAP 商业免费，但需遵守其禁止条款
包体积考虑：简单场景用原生 CSS；复杂才引入库
React 项目优先 motion / react-three-fiber；原生 JS 优先 anime.js / three.js
3D 需降级：WebGL 检测 + 静态预览图后备
所有动效需 prefers-reduced-motion 降级

performance_budgets.notes: 体积预算由项目自定；用打包分析实测并按需拆包，3D 场景懒加载
